svg.title: About Ishan
svg.desc: About: I take ideas from the first sketch to a working product — web experiences, Python tools, data and AI experiments. Status: open to build. The loop: learn, build, ship, improve. Focus: AI experiments, web products, Python projects. Daily drivers: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Git, GitHub Actions.
